Context: Offer card name of Mod.Ricochet (modifiers.md Text).

zh-Hans: 命中的子弹会弹射到新的敌人身上。
Context: Offer card line of Mod.Ricochet: describes the behaviour, never a catalog number.

Context: Offer card name of Mod.Homing (modifiers.md Text).

Context: Offer card line of Mod.Homing: describes the behaviour, never a catalog number.

Context: Offer card line of Mod.SpreadWave: describes the behaviour, never a catalog number.
